title: State Arts In Family
about: The people, projects, and shared experiences that turned State Arts-In from a production into a family.
description: This track brings together the people and memories that defined my first State Arts-In experience. It begins with the Tech Crew family formed through spaceships, platforms, extension cords, radios, and endless backstage work, then expands to the larger State Arts-In family of performers, costumers, tech crew, mentors, and friends. Looking back, the production itself wasn't what mattered most. The lasting part was discovering that family can be found through shared work, laughter, mistakes, and the people standing beside you.
